item.title: Search tool that only returns content created before ChatGPT's public release
item.description:
📝 Slop Evader — Tega Brain ︎ TEGA BRAINABOUTNEWSWORKCONTACT TEACHING A browser extension for avoiding AI slop. This is a search tool that will only return content created before ChatGPT's first public release on November 30, 2022. This browser extension uses the Google search API to only return content published before Nov 30th, 2022 so you can be sure that it was written or produced by the human hand.
🔗 Read more: https://tegabrain.com/Slop-Evader
